Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing the removal of county elected officials.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the removal of county elected officials;amending RCW 36.29.090; and adding a new section to chapter 36.16 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Whenever an action based upon official misconduct is commencedagainst any elected county official the county commissioners maysuspend the elected official from office until such suit is determined,and may appoint some person to fill the vacancy in accordance withchapter 42.12 RCW. (2) For purposes of this section, "action based upon officialmisconduct" means any action by a court or quasijudicial entity thatis based on wrongful conduct that affects, interrupts, or interfereswith the performance of official's duty.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.29.090 and 2001 c 299 s 6 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Whenever an action based upon official misconduct as defined insection 1 of this act is commenced against any county treasurer or the p. 1 SB 5060combined office of treasurerassessor the county commissioners maysuspend the treasurer or treasurerassessor from office until such suitis determined, and may appoint some person to fill the vacancy.
